newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RUGBY UNION-ACT BEAT FREE STATE 50-23 IN SUPER 12.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ACT BEAT FREE STATE 50-23 IN SUPER 12.

text.p: Australian Capital Territory (ACT) beat Free State 50-23 (halftime 23-11) in a Super 12 rugby union match at Bruce Stadium on Friday.
ACT - Tries: Joe Roff (2), Brett Robinson, James Holbeck, Mitch Hardy, Stephen Larkham. Conversions: David Knox (4). Penalties: Knox (4).
Free State - Tries: Naka Drotske, penalty try, Stephen Brink. Conversion: Jannie de Beer. Penalties: De Beer (2).
